sections.title: Plants in Ancient Mesopotamia: A Transdisciplinary Approach
sections.description: This course explores the role of plants in ancient Mesopotamia from a transdisciplinary perspective. will examine a wide array of sources, including texts, archaeobotanical data, and artistic representations to understand the cultural, economic, and symbolic significance of plants in Mesopotamian societies. The course also incorporates contemporary theoretical perspectives, such as Critical Plant Studies, to enrich the analysis of ancient evidence and foster a nuanced understanding of human-plant relationships in Mesopotamia.
